title: AddProductsToQuoteResponse
description: Response model when adding details to a quote via API.

QuoteId.description: The unique Id which identifies this quote.

Errors.description:
Errors will contain issues with specific details and will indicate that the detail will likely be incorrect or not
added.

Comments.description:
Comments will contain warnings or comments about specific details that you may want to take note of but should not
prevent the detail from being added.
